# NET-009: Provider firewall (outside view)

- **Group:** Firewall and exposure
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

A cloud provider's network firewall acts before traffic reaches the host, and before Docker's iptables rules, which makes it the best second layer. It cannot be seen from inside the host, so this result is always unknown on the host. Run stackward probe from another machine to see what is actually reachable.

## Verify by hand

```sh
stackward probe <host> --i-own-this  # run from another machine
```

## How to fix it

Add a provider network firewall that allows only the ports your ingress needs

Run `stackward explain NET-009` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
